stories.title: RUSSIA HITS KYIV BRIDGES
stories.text: Overnight drones and missiles kill several people and hit three Kyiv bridges. Poland probes an airspace breach.

stories.title: COP31 TALKS OVERRUN
stories.text: Antalya summit misses its Friday close. A draft that leaves out fossil fuels splits nations.

stories.title: UK AND EU HOLD SUMMIT
stories.text: Leaders meet to rebuild ties strained by Brexit, with trade and security on the table.

stories.title: CYCLONE AKVAN HITS INDIA
stories.text: Storm makes landfall near Gopalpur, Odisha, bringing heavy rain to the east coast.

stories.title: M6.7 EARTHQUAKE IN PERU
stories.text: Deep quake in Junin cracks a hospital and cuts power. No injuries were reported.

stories.title: CALLS FOR MYANMAR SANCTIONS
stories.text: Rights groups react after the World Court ruled 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya.

stories.title: IRAN WAR CURB FAILS
stories.text: Senate rejects war powers resolution 51-48. The Pentagon puts the war's cost above $48 billion.

stories.title: AUSTRALIA AND CHINA TO TALK AI
stories.text: PM Albanese and Premier Li Qiang agree to open talks on artificial intelligence in Beijing.

stories.title: RECORD AI IPO IN FOCUS
stories.text: Anthropic shares trade a day after the biggest stock market debut on record.
